core_frameworks: QUOTE_CARD — Clean customer quote with attribution, photo placeholder, and star rating for trust
BEFORE_AFTER — Split transformation visual showing clear results with customer testimony
STAR_RATING — Bold aggregate rating display with review count and highlighted customer quote
UGC_SCREENSHOT — Authentic-feeling social media screenshot of real customer review or comment
VIDEO_REVIEW_STILL — Thumbnail-style frame from a customer video review with quote overlay
EXPERT_ENDORSEMENT — Professional recommendation from industry expert, influencer, or authority
MULTI_REVIEW — Compilation of multiple short reviews creating overwhelming social proof wall
RESULT_STAT — Data-driven testimonial featuring specific metrics, percentages, and outcome stats

tiktok.creative_rules: Real customer review showcase with authentic feel. Text overlay style reviews. Screenshot-aesthetic testimonials. Before/after reveals. Quick quote flashes. Genuine unpolished energy. Full-screen 9:16 vertical.

meta.creative_rules: Trust-building review card with star rating prominent. Customer quote as headline. Professional design with authentic voice. Social proof numbers visible. Shop Now CTA integration. 4:5 portrait for maximum feed visibility.

youtube.creative_rules: Review compilation thumbnail quality. Star rating visual dominant. Customer face placeholder for video reviews. Bold quote text overlay. Click-worthy testimonial design. 16:9 landscape.

pinterest.creative_rules: Elegant testimonial quote card. Before/after transformation pin. Aspirational result showcase. Save-worthy customer story. Clean typography with brand colors. 2:3 vertical pin.

instagram.creative_rules: Aesthetic testimonial card that fits the feed. Quote highlight with brand-consistent design. UGC-style screenshot reviews. Before/after transformation carousels. Trust elements visible. 4:5 portrait.

facebook.creative_rules: Trust-building review design. Star rating compilation. Share-worthy customer stories. Community-driven social proof. Verified purchase badges. 4:5 portrait or 1:1 square.

x.creative_rules: Screenshot-style real review. Data-driven result stat. Proof-based social proof visual. Bold quote with attribution. Sharp professional design. 16:9 landscape.
